WITH entries AS (
  SELECT file_id, source_id, source_text, disposition,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY file_id ORDER BY entry_no DESC) AS entry_rank
  FROM inspection_log
), eligible AS (
  SELECT f.reel_code, f.file_id, e.source_id, e.source_text,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.reel_code ORDER BY f.rev_no DESC) AS revision_rank
  FROM caption_files AS f
  JOIN entries AS e ON e.file_id = f.file_id
  WHERE e.entry_rank = 1 AND e.disposition = 'clear'
)
SELECT reel_code, file_id, source_id, source_text
FROM eligible
WHERE revision_rank = 1
ORDER BY reel_code ASC
